title: Community chair class
description: A short chair sequence for community halls, libraries and seniors' groups. Everything happens seated or holding the chair.

title: Evening wind-down
description: Slow floor poses to let the day go before sleep.

title: Gentle morning
description: About ten easy minutes to wake up the spine, hips and legs. Suits beginners and stiff mornings.

title: Standing foundations
description: The core standing poses, one side at a time, with time to find the shape. A good base for a beginners' course.
